Q: SQL adding numbers while handling nulls A:

I believe you'll need to have SQL replace nulls with a zero using "ISNULL".

Try: SELECT sum(ISNULL(fix_bat_sum.foo, 0) + ISNULL(fix_bat_sum.bar, 0) ) AS Sum

Q: Addition with NULL values A:

In SQL terms, when adding numbers, a result of NULL means there were no non-null numbers added.

This suggests that a sensible answer in SQL terms would be

CASE 
        WHEN A IS NULL
            AND B IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE ISNULL(A, 0) + ISNULL(B, 0)
        END
